name: medieval-code

scripts.build: npm run build -w @medieval-code/model && npm run build -w @medieval-code/parser && npm run build -w @medieval-code/layout && npm run build -w @medieval-code/cli && npm run build -w @medieval-code/viewer
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/model --noEmit && tsc -p packages/parser --noEmit && tsc -p packages/layout --noEmit && tsc -p packages/cli --noEmit && tsc -p packages/viewer --noEmit

description: Visualize a codebase as an interactive medieval voxel town.
